marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind east 15 knots veering to southeast 20 late this morning
then to southwest 15 late overnight. Wind increasing to southwest 20 Sunday
afternoon and to southwest 25 Sunday evening. Scattered flurries this morning with a risk of freezing
drizzle. Periods of snow this afternoon this evening Sunday afternoon and
evening. Fog patches dissipating this afternoon. Visibility 1 mile or less in
fog patches and as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>
